notes.title: Upcoming major update
notes.notes:
[p]News for the coming major update :
-- Next major update will include all new enemy spawning mechanic for the Farm and Ruins level. This change will make the gameplay more fast paced and dynamic. The Town level is going to be unchanged for the players that liked the original spawning mechanic.
-- Introduction of Mini Bosses. The 3 new Mini Boss will spawn throughout the quest run. Mini Bosses are tougher and stronger enemy types than normal ones but not as strong as the Main Bosses that are unique on every level.
-- Bug fixes, memory optimizations and many more.

Thank you to all the supporters and please keep the suggestions coming so I can further refine the game into your liking[/p]

notes.title: Major Patch 0.8.6-2625
notes.notes: [p]Changelog:[/p][p]--Addition of DNA Splicing--Unlocked by talking to Mad Scientist Victoria and spending 1 Centrite Shard to splice another job class's DNA into your chosen class which lets you use all that chosen class's "unlocked skills" and use Combo Skills. [/p][p]--Combo Skills are skills that combine two level 5 job class's skills. Combo Skills use your combined magic and physical attack as source for damage. So if a Combo Skill has 500 damage and your character has 150% physical attack and 100% magic attack, the damage output would be 250% = 1250 damage.[/p][p]--Every job class has different sets of Combo Skills unique to that job class so experiment on your favorite job class and see what Combo Skill suits your playstyle[/p][p]--Added Dash ability. This can be used for distancing from enemies or evasion as this ability makes you impervious to damage for a brief moment. Every job class has varying Dash cooldown and Dash distance[/p][p]--Added UI to show what skills you have picked during a quest run. G key for keyboard[/p][p]--Added Mii-chan's game mechanics explanation dialogue on the start of quest runs[/p][p]--Tweaked Knockback[/p][p]--Tweaked some skill buffs for better scaling[/p][p]--Tweaked Leveling up for optimization[/p][p]--Fixed miscalculation of magic damage[/p][p]--Fixed Dragon's Wrath skill not doing damage[/p][p]--Fixed Howl of the Wolf wrong stats[/p][p]--Fixed Predatoy Sense wrong stats[/p][p]--Optimized skills damage system[/p][p]--Fixed various skill related bugs[/p][p]--Changed lifespan of Rune trap skills from 5 mins to 3 mins[/p]

notes.title: Upcoming major update
notes.notes:
News for the coming major update :
I am currently working hard to release the next major update next month. This major update includes the new feature "DNA Splicing" which will combine 2 job class skills, new UI that will show which skills you have chosen during a quest run, Dash ability and tons of changes and bug fixes. Please keep on giving feedback so we can refine the game to your ideal game. Thank you

notes.title: Announcement about the patches the game will be receiving from now on
notes.notes: Incremental patches will be ceasing except for bug fixes. The game will be moving towards major patches that includes more changes and gameplay additions rather than the previous small additions every week or 2 weeks.
